cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As co-organizer of Saturday's school trip, initial this bus route. I'll check the final copy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only offered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Add the stop and sign the correction, please. A verbal warning won't amend the plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll do that together. Give me the revised times; I'll prepare the notice and you'll sign as transport lead. We need one agreed account.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects verbal warning into signed amendment and A5 separate blame into joint notice, using supervisory process to make B officially share the trip outcome.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 omitted museum leads A3 correction and signature; B4 refuses explaining delays, causing A5 agreed signed account.

relationship.evidence: B2 has genuinely limited volunteer scope and a valid catch; A acknowledges it rather than making B incompetent.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 accountability boundary to assign a formal transport role in the explanation.

specificity.evidence: A1 school trip, route and B2 museum establish the task and material omission.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 one-account rationale supports a concrete notice rather than merely declaring shared responsibility.
